name: wallet
description: The wallet (shruggr/skein-wallet): the record keeper of every output the instance owns, BSV and token outputs alike (it knows nothing about tokens). One record per output: its outpoint, its key derivation {protocol: [level, name], keyID, counterparty}, its basket, its satoshis, its state (unspent | spent, with the spender | void: the paying transaction rejected). The basket is the name the kernel checked on the call: another app files an output in its own step with the named call callAs(<this program>, "file", "<basket>", {outpoint: "<txid>.<vout>", protocol, keyID, counterparty}) — its manifest declares calls {wallet: ["<basket>"]}, root approves it at install; a call without a name is refused. The transaction must be one the chain state holds (the caller ingests it at the chain app first, in the same step). Idempotent on the outpoint; the claim is not checked against the script (the basket permission is the whole safeguard). The state is read from the chain app's facts, chain/tx/<txid> and chain/output/<txid>.<vout>, at filing and on every later fact (the wallet subscribes to both); the satoshi tally per basket counts the unspent outputs only. Reads, open, nothing logged: GET /wallet/outputs?basket=&after=<txid>.<vout>&limit= (the basket's unspent outputs with their derivations, {basket, outputs, next}) and GET /wallet/balance?basket= ({basket, satoshis}). The wallet never builds or signs a transaction, has no spend route and emits nothing about coins.
